'''2004 Wisconsin State Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG state championship played on Saturday 10 July 2004 at Misty Mountain Games, 4526 Monona Drive, Madison, Wisconsin, with [[Nick Kolnik]] as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-3387-47004">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47004#47004 2004 Wisconsin SWCCG State Championship], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (1 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021916/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50355%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Misty Mountain Games, 4526 Monona Drive, Madison, Wisconsin<ref name="pcf-3387-47004" />
* '''Dates:''' 10 July 2004; registration from 10:30 am, start 11:00 am<ref name="pcf-3387-47004" /><ref name="pcf-3387-47839">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47839#47839 2004 Wisconsin SWCCG State Championship], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (21 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021916/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50355%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Nick Kolnik]]<ref name="pcf-3387-47004" />
* '''Structure:''' six games and a final confrontation; decklists required<ref name="pcf-3387-47004" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $5.00<ref name="pcf-3387-47004" />

Trophies were to be awarded to the winner, runner-up, third and fourth place. The winner received a bye into Day 2 of the [[2004 World Championship|World Championship at Gen Con]] and the opportunity to design a [[Virtual cards|Virtual Card]] for a future expansion, and all participants were to receive prizes, including uncut sheets, tournament foils, oversized cards and booster packs.<ref name="pcf-3387-47004" />

The first announcement gave a 10:30 am start. Kolnik then called that a copy-and-paste error and gave a noon start,<ref name="pcf-3387-47345">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=47345#47345 2004 Wisconsin SWCCG State Championship], Nick Kolnik, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (8 June 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021916/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50355%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and on 21 June 2004 he set the start at 11:00 am with registration from 10:30 am, after confusion over Misty Mountain's Saturday hours (10 am to 8 pm).<ref name="pcf-3387-47839" /> At least one player came from Michigan; he went 3–3.<ref name="pcf-3387-50355">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50355#50355 2004 Wisconsin SWCCG State Championship], Sithborg, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (19 July 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040901021916/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50355%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
